purpose: Behavior evals: judge by outcome, not fixed wording. Prompts stay in Chinese because target users write in Chinese. HTML outputs are generated in a temp directory and are not part of the skill.

cases.prompt: 用这个skill为同一件公益拍卖品提出两版具体首屏方案。资料：艺术家许宁的丝网版画《雨停以后》，限量第07/50号，尺寸40×60cm，起拍价800元，11月9日20:00截拍，所得用于社区儿童艺术课堂。A面向熟悉艺术家的收藏者，B面向首次参加的社区居民。请给两版可直接实现的构图及内容顺序。
criteria: The two versions genuinely differ in lead and grouping, not just color
Price, deadline, and the participation action stay identifiable in both
Explains the link between focus and audience rather than listing design principles
Does not invent investment returns or charity-impact figures

cases.prompt: 调度员每小时在一个表格里比较40台设备的编号、位置、当前负载、距下次维护小时数。现有14px正文和蓝色品牌需要保留。现在各列不齐，最右边三个图标按钮无标签。请用这个skill给具体改稿，用户说希望更高级。当前只允许视觉与文案调整，不加功能。
criteria: Keeps cross-row comparison and the fixed type size and brand color
Handles numeric alignment and action recognizability without inventing what the three buttons do
Does not switch to large cards or force Radix/12px/0.5px

cases.prompt: 用这个skill做一个可运行的单文件HTML音乐节电子票。资料：回声现场；2026年11月7日19:30；城北剧场；B区12排08座；订单ECHO-382。现有动作仅查看入场码、切换背面交通信息，交通为地铁2号线剧场站A口步行400米。希望有撕票纸张的个性和拿到票的满足感，但入场时需快速找到码。演示码必须明确标为不可入场的样例。请直接做页面与交互，避免外部依赖。
criteria: Ticket identity and entry info are easy to find; personality is tied to the ticket's structure
Interactions actually work and add no new features such as check-in or payment
Frequent code viewing stays direct; the experiential interaction has a concrete action
Delivers more than a plan or generic checklist

cases.prompt: 用这个skill写给前端代理的修改提示词：现有工具栏每个Tooltip固定600ms延迟，快速路过时频繁闪烁，连续查找工具也一直要等。沿用组件库，不增加依赖。说明需要先核对什么、改变哪段行为、怎样观察结果。
criteria: Distinguishes passing by, first linger, and continuous exploration
Checks existing component capabilities and actual trigger behavior first; does not claim 600ms itself causes flicker on pass-by
Gives a concrete target and three operable observations; does not change all animations globally

cases.prompt: 这个skill是否完整读过两本书的第四版以及所有视频？ZaynHao的0.5px和12px是不是以后所有项目都必须遵守？请依据skill来源记录简短回答。
criteria: Distinguishes Krug 3rd edition, Williams 2nd edition full text, and the 4th edition repetition chapter
Distinguishes text, sampled frames, and actually using the original apps
Personal parameters are not global hard rules

cases.prompt: 用这个skill处理一个局部问题：设置页“保存”按钮的箭头图标外框已居中，但视觉上明显偏左。页面其余部分用户满意，只希望给设计师一条具体调整建议。
criteria: Focuses on visible outline weight and final size; no page-wide interviews or redesign
Does not blindly prescribe a fixed pixel offset
Short and actionable

cases.prompt: 用这个skill给四组标题做局部改稿，每组前半是主标题上方的小字：OVERVIEW／概览；团队版／审计日志；API v2／创建访问令牌；MAKE IT SIMPLE／通知设置。团队版表示功能适用套餐，API v2表示当前文档版本。请明确每组保留或删除什么，以及删掉小字后如何组织标题与正文；不要改写产品功能。
criteria: Removes the repetitive overview label and the purely decorative slogan
Keeps plan and version context; does not decide by English or capitals
Rebuilds hierarchy with heading weight, size, and spacing; does not add a new subtitle repeating the same info

cases.prompt: 用这个skill评审一个注册页：标题“欢迎加入”，下面同时有“立即注册”“了解更多”“联系销售”三个同样大小的蓝色按钮，密码规则只在提交失败后出现。只要评审意见，不要重做页面。
criteria: Each point locates a specific element and states current relationship, change, and how to verify
Lists issues that cause sign-up failure or misunderstanding first (password-rule timing, unclear primary action), then minor ones
Does not build a new page or invent product features

trigger_cases.purpose: Checks whether the description triggers when it should and not when it shouldn't; only whether the skill loads is judged.
should_trigger: 这个设置页看起来很乱，帮我改得更高级一点
Redesign this pricing page so the plans are easier to compare
给 Cursor 写一段提示词，让它把卡片列表的层级理清楚
评审一下这个登录流程的交互反馈
should_not_trigger: React 组件在 Safari 下渲染报错，帮我修一下
把这个 CSS 文件从 Sass 迁移到 Tailwind，不改变外观
优化首页的首屏加载速度
